layout: 3 columns x 4 rows, row-major: cards 2–10, then wagers 1–3

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production card-art atlas for a tap-card calculator. Generate ONE rectangular contact sheet with EXACTLY 3 columns and 4 rows, 12 equal portrait panels. Canvas aspect ratio 9:16; each panel aspect ratio 3:4. Panels fill their exact equal cells edge-to-edge, no gutters, no padding, no frames, no rounded corners. Grid boundaries exactly at 1/3 and 2/3 width and 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 height. Each cell is an independent complete original illustration. Consistent sophisticated painterly adventure board-game illustration, rich lighting, strong readable silhouettes, environmental storytelling. Not photorealistic. Keep a consistent little explorer where useful to show travel and scale. No lettering, no numbers, no icons, no watermarks; numbers are added separately in the website. Leave top-left and bottom-right corners relatively calm for number overlays. Do not merge neighboring scenes. Reading order left to right, top to bottom: first nine panels are cards 2 through 10; last three panels are wager preparation artwork. Each of the first nine scenes must visibly progress toward the discovery, not merely repeat a view. 
Theme: A yellow pyramid expedition across an Egyptian desert. Cards 2–10 get steadily closer to ancient pyramids, with 10 discovering the pyramids.
Palette: golden yellow, ochre, sandstone, warm sunlight
First nine panels:
Card 2: tiny pyramids barely visible beyond far desert dunes
Card 3: crossing windswept dunes toward faint pyramid silhouettes
Card 4: desert ridge with pyramids still distant
Card 5: ancient sandstone route marker with pyramids beyond
Card 6: approaching a ruined gateway in the desert
Card 7: pyramids rising prominently beyond the gateway
Card 8: climbing a dune at the edge of the pyramid complex
Card 9: standing at the monumental entrance to the pyramid complex
Card 10: triumphant discovery directly beneath immense pyramids
Last row: Wager 1: desert expedition map and compass on golden sand; Wager 2: packed exploration equipment and water flask beside a dune; Wager 3: small expedition tent looking toward distant pyramids
